excerpt: Wireless Presentation The supported wireless presentation receiver in central classrooms is the Kramer VIA. Kramer VIA works with an application on the presenter's laptop, tablet, or smartphone to present on the classroom presentation display without the use of a cable. This allows the presenter to freely move about the room while displaying the content from their portable device. IMPORTANT NOTES: - You must be on VCU's SafeNet Wireless to present from your device to the wireless presentation units in our spaces. - If you have a VPN enabled on your device, you must disable it or you will not be able to connect. - This resource is available only for in-room instruction. It is not available on the Zoom application on the computer. Wireless Presentation Instructions VIA Application for Android and iOS Kramer Via Centrally Managed Support For more information about our centrally managed wireless presentation support model for departments, please visit our support policy page at go.vcu.edu/wp-support.
